rules.statement: Adopted children under the Adoption of Children Ordinance are entitled to succeed to the intestate estate of their adopting Muslim parents.
rules.supporting_quote: (Jameel, J. dissenting): The Adoption of Children Ordinance has not excluded the Muslims from the provisions of this Ordinance.
